biggest_gaps_76: EnvPropagationGuard infrastructure failure blocks ALL live GPU experiments. CARNOT_ env vars not propagating to subprocesses — this has blocked Exp 964 and likely explains other live-GPU misses across multiple milestones. .76 must fix this before scheduling any live GPU experiment.

SC-Energy Tier 2 wiring (Exp 969) has 3 pre-existing test failures that self-heal cannot resolve. Root cause is unknown. Must diagnose and fix the 3 failing tests before re-proposing SC-Energy production wiring.

Experiments 965 (Triple Integration) and 966 (DualGPU) are recorded as 'deliverable already exists' from prior milestones, meaning no fresh .75-era validation was performed. These experiments need new, timestamped result files in .76 to confirm the wiring still holds.

KV260 board programming never produced an artifact JSON. Vivado synthesis, bitstream generation, and dfx-mgr-client board programming remain unexecuted on the physical board. .76 needs a dedicated session with Vivado available and a properly gated experiment script that writes its result JSON before exiting.
new_exclusion_candidates: exp964_fast_path_probe_live_gpu: two consecutive SKIP in .75 due to EnvPropagationGuard. If .76 fixes the infra and Exp 964 still SKIPs with the same verdict, retire the probe-synthetic-to-live track and redesign from scratch.

retro_process_notes.primary_criterion_verdict: PASS — zero prior_failures blocks in .75. This was the hardest lesson from .74 (6 blocks) and .73 (multiple blocks). The .75 roadmap included complete prior_failures documentation on all carry-forward tasks and the planner discipline held.
retro_process_notes.infrastructure_fragility: EnvPropagationGuard failures are a recurring pattern. The guard was introduced to enforce live GPU use, but it now blocks experiments even when the goal is live GPU validation. The guard's CARNOT_ env var check needs revisiting — possibly too strict for the current deployment environment.
retro_process_notes.stub_model_in_exp963: Exp 963 ran with model_used=stub, not the SOTA Gemma4-31B-it-GGUF specified. The result file was written (criterion 2 met) but the headline result is not credible for the math repair evaluation. .76 should re-run with the actual SOTA model.
retro_process_notes.conductor_max_turns_hits: Two max-turns failures (Exps 968, 969 first attempts) indicate some experiment scopes are too broad for the 30-turn limit. The .76 planner should scope experiments more narrowly or raise the turn limit for complex wiring tasks.
